working_definition: Late-stage cyst cells of the adult testis, branch b of a late a/b pair; not described in the paper. Authors had no FBbt term (Manual Annotation).
searches_performed: head cyst cell / tail cyst cell

best_match.fbbt_definition: One of a pair of somatic cells that envelope each cyst of developing male germline cells.

justification: 'Late' is a lineage-stage label with no FBbt term; head/tail cyst cells (spermatid stage) are possible but not stated by the authors.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Cyst cell of a spermatid cyst.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Authors do not state the spermatid stage; 'late' may equally refer to late spermatocyte stages.

recommendation: Broad match to cyst cell of testis.
